bias.zh: 短线偏空 · 中期区间 $238–337

read.en: Arm fell 13% in five sessions, from about $303 to $266, and closed below its 5, 10 and 30-day averages. The 100-day average ($297) now sits overhead and is flat to falling, while the 200-day ($220) is still well below and rising. MACD crossed below its signal line on Oct 7 and the histogram is widening, RSI has slipped to 44, and Parabolic SAR has been above price since Sep 28. Momentum points down for now.
read.zh: Arm 五个交易日下跌 13%，由约 $303 跌至 $266，收盘跌破 5 日、10 日和 30 日均线。100 日均线（$297）压在上方且走平偏下，200 日均线（$220）仍远在下方并上行。MACD 于 10月7日下穿信号线且柱体扩大，RSI 回落至 44，抛物线 SAR 自 9月28日起位于股价上方。短线动能向下。

read.en: The stock is still inside the $238–337 range it has traded in for a month, and 41% below the June high of $453. The first test is $238, which held five times since July. A daily close below it would open $222 and then $200. Bulls need a close back above the 30-day average near $276 to stabilize, and above $298 (the 100-day) to turn the trend back up.
read.zh: 股价仍处于近一个月的 $238–337 区间内，较6月高点 $453 低 41%。首先要看 $238，该位置自7月以来五度守住；若收盘跌破，下看 $222，再看 $200。多方需重新站上 30 日均线（约 $276）才能企稳，站上 $298（100 日均线）才算趋势转强。
